info.title: Starfleet REST Api
info.description:
Exhaustive list of APIs for Starfleet
Following characters are not allowed in manifest request i.e '&' '\' '%' '#' ';'
'*'(against field name) denotes Mandatory for Imports
'^'(against field name) denotes Mandatory for Exports
Our APIs require Authentication.
Parameters:
1. API Endpoint - https://api-stage-starfleet.delhivery.com/auth/token
2. Content-Type - application/x-www-form-urlencoded
3. grant_type - 'password'
4. audience - 'StarFleet'
5. scope - "starfleet openid profile email ^\/package\/batchGeneratePackages\:POST$ ^\/package\/batchGeneratePackages\/.+\:GET$ ^\/package\/auth-track\/.+\:GET$ ^\/package\/.+\/invoice\:GET$ ^\/package\/.+\/shipping-label\:GET$ ^\/package\/.+\/upload-kyc-doc\:POST$". If this Oauth API is executed via code then you have to URL-Encode the "scope" parameter
6. client_id (that is shared with you)
7. client_secret (that is shared with you)
8. username (Your login Username)
9. password (Your Login Password)

UPUS10.description: A unique identifier as defined by UPU S10 standard

UUID4.description: A unique identifier of the form UUID4

desc*^.description: Description of the item being shipped

item_commodity_value*^.description: Item level Commodity/Taxable amount of the product, should be equal to 'product amount'

total_amount*^.description: Total amount of the item (including tax)

hsn_code*^.description: 8 Digit HSN Code for the product; mandatory for all exports from India; mandatory for B2B,B2B2C imports into India; non-mandatory for B2C, C2C imports into India

euec.description: Flag for Export using E-Commerce. Only valid in case of 'commercial' type of shipment

cu3c.description: Commodity under 3C (only required in case MEIS benefit is marked 'Yes' under 'commercial' type of shipment)

meis.description: Flag for MEIS benefit. Only valid in case of 'commercial' type of shipment

unit_price*^.description: Price of each unit of product

igst_rate.description: Integrated GST rate(percent) for product(without percentage symbol) Only valid in case of 'commercial' type of shipment and IGST payment status as 'Paid'

igst_amount.description: Integrated GST amount for product or item. Only valid in case of 'commercial' type of shipment and IGST payment status as 'Paid'

sell_weblink.description: Marketplace product weblink for price reference

contains_artificial_jewellery.description: Flag to indicate if the product contains artificial jewellery. Optional.

Contact.description: Metadata for a person acting as the contact for the consignor/consignee/eor/ior

pickup_warehouse_id*^.description: Pickup address ID as provided by Delhivery

country*^.description: Country of the postal address in universal 2 letter code format

RegisteredAddress.description: Payload for requests against a Starfleet registered address

state*^.description: 2 or 3 letter State/Region/Province of the postal address. Mandatory only in case of Exports to United States (US) and Canada (CA)

country*^.description: Country of the postal address in universal 2 letter code format

zip*^.description: Pin/Zip code of the postal address

UnregisteredAddress.description: Payload for requests against unregistered or temporary address

weight^.description: Dead weight of the shipment in grams

package_amount*^.description: Total package amount after taxes (or selling price). This will be the sum of all amounts calculated at item level and will be the final amount printed on shipping label.

total_commodity_value*^.description: Total value (before tax) of all the commodities inside the shipment. This becomes the customs declared value of the product.

currency*^.description: Currency code of all the amounts

client_name*^.description: Account Name as provided by Delhivery

transaction_type.description: Type or nature of transaction for the shipment

cod_amount.description: Amount to be collected by consignee at the time of delivery. Only applicable in case of 'COD'

service_type*^.description: Type of service for the shipment. Note: EXPORTS_DLV_SAVER is not applicable for document shipments.

billing_mode.description: Mode of billing for the shipment

battery^.description: Boolean indicative if the product is a battery requiring MSDS documentation or otherwise.

name.description: Name of Exporter On Record. Mandatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

postal.description: Complete postal address of Exporter On Record. Mandatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

phone.description: Contact number of Exporter On Record. andatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

name.description: Name of Importer On Record. Mandatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

postal.description: Complete postal address of Importer On Record. Mandatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

phone.description: Contact number of Importer On Record. andatory in case of 'transaction type' is 'B2B2C'

igst_payment_status.description: IGST payment status. Mandatory only in case of 'commercial' type of shipment

lut_bond_ref.description: LUT/Bond reference number. Only required in case IGST Payment Status is 'LUT' or 'Bond'

zip.description: Pin/Zip code of the postal address for return

bill_to.description: Billing address details. Used when the billing address differs from the shipping address.

as_shipto.description: If true, bill_to address is same as ship_to address

zip.description: Pin/Zip code of the billing address

country.description: Country code of the billing address (2 letter ISO code)

phone.description: Phone number of the billing contact

clearance_mode.description: Type of clearance mode opted for

free_domicile.description: Bill duties and/or taxes to shipper and no amount to be billed to consignee. This is an add on service (with additional charges) provided for exports out of India.

signature_pod.description: Mandatory signature POD required at the time of delivery. This is an add on service (with additional charges) provided for exports out of India.

seller_id.description: Actual Seller address ID as provided by Delhivery. All other fields inside this consignor object are not mandatory if this field is filled.

phone.description: Contact number of shipper/seller with country code

type.description: Type of address: Office or Residential

address.description: Complete postal address of the shipper/seller as per KYC or customs invoice

city.description: City of the postal address of shipper/seller as per KYC or customs invoice

state.description: State/Region/Province of the postal address of shipper/seller as per KYC or customs invoice

country.description: Two letter Country Code of the postal address of shipper/seller

zip.description: Pin/Zip code of the postal address of shipper/seller

document_id.description: ID number of the KYC document of the shipper that is provided to Delhivery

document_type.description: Name of the KYC document of the shipper that is provided to Delhivery

iec.description: Importer Exporter Code of the shipper. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services

pan.description: PAN number of shipper. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services.

gstin.description: Registered GSTIN number of the shipper. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services.

bank_ad_code.description: Authorized Dealer Code of the shipper. Should be 14 digits. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services.

bank_ifsc.description: Bank IFSC code of the shipper. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services.

bank_ac.description: Bank account no. of the shipper. This is mandatory in case of 'commercial' type of shipment under 'EXPORT' services.

e_waybill.description: E-Waybill number, mandatory for movement within India in case total shipment value is greater than 50,000 INR

PackageMetadata.description: Metadata against a package. A package represents a physical shipment being routed via Starfleet

CreatePackageBatchRequest.description: Payload to trigger a job to create/manifest shipments in bulk.

packages.description: List/Array of packages to be manifested

mps_amount.description: Only valid in case of MPS shipment. Amount that needs to be collected from consignee. Enter 0 in case it is a prepaid shipment

no_of_pieces.description: Only mandatory in case of MPS shipment. Enter total number of boxes associated with the shipment. The number entered will generate as many number of airwaybills associated with 1 master airwaybill. Leave blank in case of only 1 box.

master_waybill.description: Master Waybill for MPS Shipment. Only valid in case of MPS shipment.

payload.description: Actual payload containing results of actions implemented by API

message.description: Any metadata to explain status of the job such as error codes on a FAILED job

ApiResponse.description: Common structure for any Api response

CreateTaskApiResponse.description: Common structure for any asynchronous Api response.

TaskStatusResponse.description: Common structure for any API that indicate the status of a previously triggered task

id.description: Unique identifier/reference for the job/task created

total_count.description: Total count of packages that are being processed for manifestation

error_count.description: count of packages that failed to be manifested

success_count.description: count of packages that successfully manifested

reason.description: denotes reason for why package could not be manifested

is_master.description: True if it is an mps master shipment. Note- this key will only be present when shipment_type is MPS

related_wbns.description: List of Related AWB's of a MPS shipment. Note- this key will only be present when shipment_type is MPS

master_wbn.description: Master AWB of a MPS shipment. Note- this key will only be present when shipment_type is MPS

zip*^.description: Pin code of the postal address

success.description: Boolean value if image upload was succesful or not

message.description: Data to indicate reason of failure or indicate success
